Maya R.: Heads up — Enterprise customer Vellum Inc says their June invoice still shows a $0 promo applied instead of the $50,000 sales credit from PO PO-8812. They’re past due and unhappy. Can we triage?
Javier S.: I added the PO note in Salesforce yesterday: 'Apply promo ENTERPRISEQ2 to June invoice per contract addendum.' I thought ops would pick it up automatically.
Priya K.: Account number and invoice ID pls — I need to pull the billing ledger.
Maya R.: acct: vellum-corp-001, invoice: INV-2024-06-8812. Customer sent a screenshot showing promo code name but $0 amount on invoice.
Liam O.: grabbing ledger now. One sec.
finance-bot: Retrieved invoice INV-2024-06-8812 — status: issued, balance: $12,400, discounts: 0 USD, PO note present in CRM but not attached to billing event.
Priya K.: ok that confirms it. Looks like the PO note didn't flow into the billing pipeline. Possible causes: sales note formatting, missing promo mapping, or manual override. Javier — did you use the exact promo slug? we rely on exact matching.
Javier S.: I typed ENTERPRISEQ2 (no spaces). Salesforce note: "apply promo ENTERPRISEQ2 — see contract". I also cc'ed legal in the SF note.
Maya R.: customer insists it was contractually committed. Sales says it was included in the signed PO note.
Priya K.: repro steps for ops: 1) lookup SF opportunity PO-8812 2) confirm note body 3) run billing-sync for acct vellum-corp-001 for period 2024-06. Can someone run the sync and watch logs for promo-mapper errors?
Liam O.: running billing-sync now: command run: `./ops/billing_sync --acct vellum-corp-001 --period 2024-06 --dry-run=false`
Liam O.: tail logs: `ERROR promo-mapper: no mapping for slug "ENTERPRISE_Q2"` — ah, note the underscore. Looks like an automated normalization step replaced Q2 with _Q2 in our mapping extract.
Javier S.: hmm I didn't put an underscore in the note. Weird. Could our SF export pipeline be transforming text?
Priya K.: that explains it — our billing mapping table expects slug ENTERPRISEQ2 (no underscore). The promo-mapper treats underscores as part of slug. If export added an underscore the lookup failed and promo amount defaulted to zero.
Maya R.: customer on the line, asking for immediate remediation. What's the rollback/workaround?
Liam O.: quick fix: apply manual credit in Billing Ops for INV-2024-06-8812 amount 50000 with memo "Sales credit per PO-8812". Then run invoice recalculation. I'll queue it.
Priya K.: I'll authorize manual credit once Finance confirms GL code. Finance — can you approve GL code 45-ENT-PROMO for this manual apply?
finance-bot: Approval required: GL 45-ENT-PROMO. Approvers: Liam O., Priya K.
Javier S.: confirmed from my side — can also update SF export mapping to avoid underscore. I'll follow up with the ops export owner.
Priya K.: manual credit authorized. Liam please apply and mark as escalated-to-postmortem so we track root cause.
Liam O.: applied credit, invoice recalculated. New balance: -37,600 (credit applied). Sending adjusted invoice to customer now.
Maya R.: Customer acknowledged receipt and thanks. They want confirmation in writing and a postmortem.
Javier S.: I'll open a short postmortem in #eng-infra describing the export normalization bug and proposed fix (strip unwanted underscores before mapping).
Maya R.: thanks team. Action items: (1) Billing ops manual credit applied (done) (2) Finance GL confirmed (done) (3) Sales to patch SF export mapping (Javier) (4) Eng infra postmortem + fix + small test (Javier + eng-infra). Closing after postmortem. :thumbsup:
Priya K.: adding a calendar reminder to follow up in 72 hours.
finance-bot: Thread closed by Maya R.
